stem: The central dogma of molecular biology describes macromolecular information flow as which sequence?

options.label: A
options.text: Glucose to glycogen as the usual forward path
options.explanation: Unrelated; see the cited source passage for detail.

options.label: B
options.text: Protein to RNA to DNA as the usual forward path
options.explanation: Forward flow is DNA to RNA to protein.

options.label: C
options.text: Lipid to carbohydrate as the usual forward path
options.explanation: Not the dogma; see the cited source passage for detail.

options.label: D
options.text: DNA to RNA to protein as the usual forward path
options.misconception: None; that is the central dogma summary.
options.explanation: OpenStax: central dogma of DNA-protein synthesis.

options.label: E
options.text: ATP to heat as the usual forward path
options.explanation: Unrelated; see the cited source passage for detail.

context: Learning objective: central dogma links DNA to protein synthesis.
imageCaption: DNA double helix; strands template replication; codon triplets; central dogma DNA to protein.
